title.en: Express questionnaire on the readiness of a site for investment

documents.description: The express questionnaire itself (Uzbek or Russian version), filled in by the owner of the site.
checks: It is this questionnaire (title 'ЭКСПРЕСС-АНКЕТА' / 'ЭКСПРЕСС-АНКЕТАСИ'), not another document.
Company name, full name and position of the person who filled it in, contact phone or Telegram, and the name of the deposit / subsoil plot are all filled in (not blank lines or underscores).
Direction A (geological exploration) or B (mining / gold) is marked in step 1.
In each of the 10 items of step 2 exactly one option is marked, or the item is marked as not applicable (NA).
In item 10 the requested value of the site / share and the required investment (Capex) are filled in and one deal format is marked.
The owner's consent block (NDA) has the position, a signature and a date. A stamp is welcome but not required.

documents.description: The current version of the company charter (Устав), item 1 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is a company charter (Устав / Устав), not another document.
The company name matches the company in the questionnaire, if the questionnaire is known.
It shows that it was approved (date, decision of the founders or registration mark).

documents.description: Extract from the unified state register of enterprises and organisations, item 2 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is an extract from the state register of legal entities (ЕГРПО / ЕГРПО / my.gov.uz / Davlat xizmatlari markazi).
The company name and STIR (INN) are shown and match the questionnaire, if it is known.
The head of the company is named.
It is recent: issued no more than 3 months before today.

documents.description: Electronic subsoil use permit / licence under Cabinet of Ministers resolution No. 133, item 3 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is a subsoil use permit or licence (рухсатнома / разрешение / лицензия), usually with a QR code.
It has a number, an issue date and the holder's name; the holder matches the questionnaire's company, if known.
It is not expired today (if a validity date is shown).

documents.description: The signed licence agreement / subsoil use conditions that go with the permit, item 3 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is a licence agreement or subsoil use conditions document (лицензия келишуви / лицензионное соглашение / ер қаъридан фойдаланиш шартлари / шартнома).
It names the subsoil user and refers to a permit or plot.
It is signed (signature, electronic signature or QR code).

title.uz: Loyiha hujjatlari (UTER, TIA, tog' ajratmasi loyihasi)
title.ru: Проектная документация (УТЭР, ТЭО, проект горного отвода)
title.en: Project documents (UTER, feasibility study, mining allotment project)

documents.description: Project documentation of the site: topographic survey, exploration project, UTER, TEO of conditions, mining allotment project or working project, item 5 of the questionnaire. Each such document sent counts here.
checks: It is one of: topographic survey, geological exploration project (ГҚИ / ГРР), UTER (УТЭР), feasibility study (ТИА / ТЭО), mining allotment project (тоғ ажратмаси / горный отвод) or working project.
It names the site or the company.
It shows an approval, agreement or expert review mark, or at least a date and the developer.

documents.description: The annual geological report form 5-GR or proof that it was submitted, item 6 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is form 5-GR (5-ГР) or a receipt / letter confirming that it was submitted.
It shows the reporting year and the company or site.
The reporting year is the last or the year before last.

documents.description: Environmental documents and the state environmental expert review conclusion, item 7 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is one of: ZVOS / ZEP / OVOS (environmental impact statement), PDV, PDS or waste limits project, or the state environmental expert review conclusion.
It names the site or the company.
For an expert review conclusion: it is positive and not expired (3 years for EIA materials, 5 years for environmental standards).

documents.description: Industrial safety expert review conclusions / reports and permits to operate hazardous production facilities, item 8 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is an industrial safety expert review conclusion or report (ЭПБ / саноат хавфсизлиги экспертизаси), a registration of a hazardous production facility (ОПО) or a permit to operate it.
It names the company or the facility.
It has a number and date and is issued by an accredited expert organisation or the competent authority.

documents.description: Decisions or documents on the land allotment for the industrial site, quarry or wells, item 9 of the questionnaire.
checks: It is a land allotment decision (hokim's decision / қарор / решение), a land lease agreement or a cadastre document for the site.
It names the company and the plot (area, location).
It has a number and a date.
